people.name: Agag
people.line: Amalekite king captured and killed by Samuel

people.name: Gilgal
people.line: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Samuel said, “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women!” Then Samuel cut Agag in pieces before Yahweh in Gilgal.
translations.bsb: But Samuel declared: “As your sword has made women childless, so your mother will be childless among women.” And Samuel hacked Agag to pieces before the LORD at Gilgal.
translations.kjv: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed ➔ Agag in pieces before the LORD in Gilgal.
translations.asv: And Samuel said, As thy sword hath made women childless, so shall thy mother be childless among women. And Samuel hewed Agag in pieces before Jehovah in Gilgal.
